acceptance_criteria.description: All surface/input/jet/profile and marker/interval forecast hashes verify and all predictions precede all nonlinear receiver starts.
Independent profiles have discrete residual <2e-10 and finest eigenvalue change <=0.6 times previous change.
Every surface relative replay residual <1e-7; changed SVD cutoff is included in prediction uncertainty.
For both spectra at A=.012, finest interval change <=0.6 previous mesh change plus declared nonspatial error. Otherwise unresolved.
For both spectra at A=.012, total absolute interval budget B <= |P4-P2|/4 and |Y|>5B. Otherwise unresolved; never use the 5% record gate to resolve A4.
On each resolved converged spectrum, |Y-P4|<=B and |Y-P2|>3B; resolved violation fails, unresolved controls defer judgment.

All cases possess first/last Hermite markers and error <=0.1. On each nominal finest spectrum error <= direct mesh+time+domain+inverse+sampling+1e-6 timing budget and decreases from fine or is below that budget.
Finest +.012/-.012 marker times differ <1e-9 and intervals <1e-10 cycles for each spectrum.
All cases charge drift <1e-5 and energy residual <1% of incident energy.

known_gaps: Linear synthetic surface acquisition with exact known support and incoming derivative rule.
SVD estimates initial data, not a response coefficient; cutoff sensitivity is explicitly budgeted.
Independent profile refinement changes the discrete preparation and does not certify clock longevity.
Flat spherical shells; no two-object recoil, invariance, gravity, angular stability or emergent spacetime.
Original Test 7 remains failed and Test 8 requires a separate acceptance review.
